justifications.r1: Mahadi creates Treasures for every creature that dies each turn, generating massive burst mana.
justifications.r2: Bolas's Citadel and aristocrat draw triggers refuel hand.
justifications.a1: Sacrifice outlet and creature death redundancy.
justifications.p1: Presents lethal Bolas's Citadel drain on Turns 6–7.
justifications.p2: 1–2 opponent untap steps to close out game.
justifications.p3: Citadel is telegraphed, but generates immediate win lines.
justifications.s2: Treasures remain after creature board wipes.
justifications.s3: Aristocrat engine functions moderately well without Mahadi.
